guidebook.intro: Simu, ujumbe na salio. Haya ndiyo unayohitaji kwa simu ya Kiingereza.

tips.title: Me, you, him
body: Kiswahili huweka “mimi” na “wewe” ndani ya kitenzi (**ni-ta-ku-pigia**). Kiingereza huyaweka **baada** ya kitenzi: **I’ll call you**, **Call me**.
Maneno hayo ni: **me, you, him, her, it, us, them**. **Nitampigia** ni **I’ll call him** au **I’ll call her**.

culture.title: Kuanza simu
body: Kwenye simu, Kiingereza husema **Hello?** kisha **This is Amani** (ni Amani), si “I am Amani”. Kuuliza mtu: **Can I speak to Juma, please?**
